notes.title: Friendmocracy is Releasing This Week
notes.content:
[h1]Friendmocracy Releases This Week!![/h1]
Friendmocracy will be releasing this week! It's been a very exciting time to see how a fun project turned into a fully fleshed game. When the game releases we'll be looking out for streams of the game and listening to community input to see what we can do to improve Friendmocracy.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
Friendmocracy will be updated regularly, adding new features, fixing bugs and making sure the game is in the best state that it can be! Don't be afraid to reach out with suggestions and feedback about the game!

Thank you for reading, we're excited to for the game to be released!
- Chris Price
